name: Nils von Brunn
source:
Nils von Brunn stands like a calm amongst the screwy storm that happens to be Gilda's life now—and fate seems to love making her cross paths with this foreign diplomat again and again. Not that Gilda's complaining, but is everything truly on the level with him?

[From [url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/lets-misbehave]itch.io[/url]]
